teaser.en: Its giant sausage-shaped fruits hang on rope-like stalks and are used to ferment traditional beer.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake makubwa mno yenye umbo la soseji huning'inia kwenye mashina kama kamba na hutumika kuchachusha pombe ya kienyeji.
teaser.dg: Matundage makulu sana ga umbo dza soseji ganabwadzika kpwa milita mire dza kamba, na nkuhumirwa kuhenda uchi wa chienyeji uumuke.

summary.en: *Mvungunya*, the sausage tree, is a riverine tree with dark red bell flowers on long rope-like stalks and huge sausage-shaped fruits. The fruit is used to ferment traditional beer, the wood makes mortars, canoes and beehives, and the tree is widely revered.
summary.sw: *Mvungunya*, au *mwegea*, ni mti wa kando ya mito wenye maua mekundu iliyokolea yenye umbo la kengele kwenye mashina marefu kama kamba, na matunda makubwa mno yenye umbo la soseji. Tunda hutumika kuchachusha pombe ya kienyeji, mbao hutengeneza vinu, mitumbwi na mizinga ya nyuki, na mti huu unaheshimiwa sana katika maeneo mengi.
summary.dg: *Mvungunya* ni muhi wa kanda-kanda ya miho, wenye maruwa ga kundu sana ga umbo dza kengele ganagobwadzika kpwa milita mire dza kamba, na matunda makulu sana ga umbo dza soseji. Tunda nkuhumirwa kuhenda uchi wa chienyeji uumuke, nyama za muhi nkuhendwa vinu, mitumbwi na mizinga ya nyuchi, na muhi uhu unaishimiwa ni atu anji.

about.en:
*Mvungunya* is impossible to mistake. Its dark red, bell-shaped flowers hang on rope-like stalks two to three metres long. They open at night and are visited by bats.

The fruits that follow are huge, sausage-shaped and heavy, dangling from the same long stalks. The leaves are rough and grow in threes. The tree is semi-deciduous, dropping some of its leaves in the dry season.
about.sw:
*Mvungunya* hauwezi kukosewa. Maua yake mekundu iliyokolea yenye umbo la kengele huning'inia kwenye mashina kama kamba yenye urefu wa mita mbili hadi tatu. Huchanua usiku na hutembelewa na popo.

Matunda yanayofuata ni makubwa mno, yenye umbo la soseji na mazito, yakining'inia kwenye mashina yale yale marefu. Majani yanakwaruza na huota matatu matatu. Mti huu hupukutisha sehemu ya majani yake wakati wa kiangazi.
about.dg:
*Mvungunya* ni rahisi sana kuumanya. Maruwage ga kundu sana, ga umbo dza kengele, ganabwadzika kpwa milita mire dza kamba, ya ure wa mita mbiri hadi tahu. Ganavuguka usiku na nkuedzerwa ni manundu.

Matunda ganagoedza nyuma ni makulu sana, ga umbo dza soseji, na ni maziho, ganabwadzika kpwa milita ihiyo mire. Makodzage ni ga kukaraza na ganamera mahahu-mahahu. Makodzage ganjina nkugbwa wakati wa kazikazi, ela tagagbwa gosi.

where.en: It grows in riverine forest and wooded grassland. The hanging fruits make it easy to spot all year.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya kando ya mito na nyika zenye miti. Matunda yanayoning'inia huufanya uwe rahisi kuuona mwaka mzima.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga kanda-kanda ya miho na kpwenye mavuwe genye mihi. Matundage ganagobwadzika ganahenda uonekane rahisi mwaka wosi.

uses.en:
The fruits are used to ferment traditional beer, and the Digo are among the peoples recorded doing this.

The wood is used for mortars, canoes and beehives. The fruit, bark and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Matunda hutumika kuchachusha pombe ya kienyeji, na Wadigo ni miongoni mwa jamii zilizorekodiwa zikifanya hivyo.

Mbao hutumika kwa vinu, mitumbwi na mizinga ya nyuki. Tunda, gome na mizizi hutumika katika tiba ya jadi.
uses.dg:
Matunda nkuhumirwa kuhenda uchi wa chienyeji uumuke, na Adigo ni kahi ya atu anaoandikpwa kuhenda vivi.

Nyama za muhi nkuhendwa vinu, mitumbwi na mizinga ya nyuchi. Matunda, gopha na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: The sausage tree is widely revered as a ceremonial tree. One of its Digo names, *mratina*, comes from the name of the brew, *muratina*, that its fruit helps make.
culture.sw: Mwegea unaheshimiwa sana katika maeneo mengi kama mti wa sherehe za kimila. Mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo, *mratina*, linatokana na jina la pombe, *muratina*, ambayo tunda lake husaidia kuitengeneza.
culture.dg: *Mvungunya* unaishimiwa sana dza muhi wa chimila. Dzina ranjina ra Chidigo, *mratina*, rinatuluka kpwa dzina ra uchi *muratina*, ambao matundage nkuterya kuuhenda.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mvungunya* and *mratina*, the second borrowed from the name of the beer *muratina*. In Swahili it is *mwegea*, *mwengea* or *mvungunya*, and in Giriama *mobwoka* or *muratina*. In English it is the sausage tree.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mvungunya* na *mratina*, la pili likiwa limetoholewa kutoka jina la pombe *muratina*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mwegea*, *mwengea* au *mvungunya*, na kwa Kigiriama *mobwoka* au *muratina*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *sausage tree*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mvungunya* na *mratina*; ra phiri rikahalwa kula dzina ra uchi *muratina*. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mwegea*, *mwengea* au *mvungunya*, na kpwa Chigiryama *mobwoka* au *muratina*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sausage tree*.

reason.sw: Pink jacaranda, wa familia moja ya maua ya tarumbeta
reason.dg: *Mgodo* (pink jacaranda), jamii mwenga ya maruwa ga umbo dza ndzumari.

reason.sw: Jamaa yake mwenye maua ya tarumbeta
reason.dg: Ndugu wenye maruwa ga umbo dza ndzumari.
